item.title: Defrag98: Windows 98 Disk Defragmenter Simulator Online
item.description:
📝 Pick a drive, cue the hard drive sounds, and relive the nostalgia of watching your disk defragment, just like the good old days of 1998. Defrag98 is a nostalgia simulator only. It runs entirely in your browser, works offline as an installable web app, and never reads, moves or modifies any real files on your device.
🔗 Read more: https://defrag98.com
